title: phyllitis nigripes
intro: Phyllitis nigripes, commonly known as Black spleenwort or Black-leaved Phyllitis, is a type of fern species in the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Phyllitis nigripes include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in wound healing and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents present in Phyllitis nigripes include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
